law: a family under the cut contract holds every BLOCKING arm of scripts/check/family-cut and never grows a pinned counter
policy: decrease-only: a pinned counter may shrink -- and must then be lowered here -- but may never grow
roster: a family enters this file when its cut work order opens and leaves the debt columns at 0 when the cut closes; `cut` names the owning work order

button.cutNote: WO-FAM-01: the 32 shadow channels and the label weight/family are emitted by derivation/chrome/button; the press recipe timing is stamped onto the button channels; one `ds-` vocabulary. Two pins stay above 0 for adjudication, never by a fabricated reader: partsStampedNotConsumed=1 is `trigger`, the default root part a composite may rename (P-79), so the skin anchors on `[data-variant]` and the part is read by the anatomy skeleton renderer instead; fanOutUnreached=1 is `recipe-profile`, whose only channel `--ds-recipe-profile` is provenance owned by WO-DER-06 while the profile reaches the button through the runtime.

checkbox.cutNote: WO-FAM-01: every channel the Modern skin reads is written -- decision relations by derivation/chrome/checkbox, structural constants by presentation/components/checkbox; state decided by the interaction kernel on the root; one ds- vocabulary. fanOutUnreached=1 is recipe-profile: RecipeProfileDefaultsByFamily declares no checkbox axis and its only channel is provenance owned by WO-DER-06.

radio.cutNote: WO-FAM-01: every channel the Modern skin reads is written -- decision relations by derivation/chrome/radio, structural constants by presentation/components/radio; state decided by the interaction kernel on the root and on each Radio.Group segment; the segment colour resolves from data-color, never from inline channels; one ds- vocabulary. fanOutUnreached=1 is recipe-profile: RecipeProfileDefaultsByFamily declares no radio axis and its only channel is provenance owned by WO-DER-06.

toggle.cutNote: WO-FAM-01: Switch and Toggle are one family (D-16); Toggle keeps the richer contract and absorbs Switch's busy semantics, click value, ref and accessible-name paths, and Switch survives only as a deprecated alias compound. Decision relations by derivation/chrome/toggle, constants by presentation/components/toggle; one ds-toggle vocabulary and one --ds-toggle-* namespace read by the skin. fanOutUnreached=1 is recipe-profile: no toggle axis exists and its only channel is provenance owned by WO-DER-06.

segmented.cutNote: WO-FAM-01: every channel the Modern skin reads is written -- option geometry, frame, depth, hover and selected weight by derivation/chrome/segmented, structural constants by presentation/components/segmented; root hover decided by the interaction kernel; one ds-segmented vocabulary. partsStampedNotConsumed=1 is `root`, the default part a composite may rename (P-79), so the skin anchors on role=radiogroup and the part is read by the anatomy skeleton renderer instead; held for adjudication rather than fabricating a reader. WO-EVI-05: channelsRead 101 -> 103 is the dial-scaled `--ds-motion-feedback` and `--ds-motion-reveal` the transitions now read, each with its raw rung as fallback; readWithoutProducer stays 0.

input.cutNote: WO-FAM-02: every channel the Modern skin reads is written -- field relations by derivation/chrome/input, structural constants by presentation/components/input; clear, search and reveal actions decide state through the field-action kernel; one ds-input vocabulary (the rottay-input classes and the comment-only input-residual skin are gone). Two pins stay above 0 for adjudication, never by a fabricated stamp: partsConsumedNotStamped=1 is `trigger`, the Select trigger part the input-compounds skin composes inside a compact Input.Group (select is WO-FAM-03's family); fanOutUnreached=1 is recipe-profile, whose only channel is provenance owned by WO-DER-06.

textarea.cutNote: WO-FAM-02: field relations by derivation/chrome/textarea on the input grammar, constants by presentation/components/textarea; root and clear action governed by the interaction and field-action kernels; Enter commits through resolveSubmitIntent (multiline).

password-input.cutNote: WO-FAM-02: the --ds-password-* channels answer to --ds-password-input-*, the strength tones are theme relations (the contract carries no colour), the error ink is the readable error root; visibility toggle governed by the interaction kernel.

otp-input.cutNote: WO-FAM-02: the --ds-otp-* channels answer to --ds-otp-input-*; slots governed by the interaction kernel; composition commits only on compositionend.

tag-input.cutNote: WO-FAM-02: container relations by derivation/chrome/tag-input, constants by presentation/components/tag-input; root governed by the interaction kernel; the unpainted live region no longer stamps a part; separator and Enter never commit while composing.

input-number.cutNote: WO-FAM-02: one --ds-input-number-* namespace (the vertical chrome's --ds-inputnumber-* emission and the rustic floors were renamed), so tenant input-number chrome reaches the Modern engine; root and steppers governed by the interaction kernel; the legacy stepper glyph is gone.

form-field.cutNote: WO-FAM-02: label and message relations by derivation/chrome/form-field, constants by presentation/components/form-field (moved out of the input token file); the reserved message lines travel as the runtime --ds-form-field-message-lines channel.

form.cutNote: WO-FAM-02: pinned owner src/components/primitives/inputs/form (the name is shared with the FormHeader structure, which keeps its own skin); both engines render from runtime/{state,validation}; FORM_DEFAULTS.layout is vertical (D-22); adapt/data-posture through useAdaptation; FormSurface answers to ds-form-surface so the form vocabulary is the primitive's alone.

select.cutNote: WO-FAM-03: every channel the Modern skin reads is written -- field and dropdown relations by derivation/chrome/select, structural constants by presentation/components/select; keyboard and type-ahead come from runtime/collection/listbox, the dropdown from useFieldOverlay, and clear, tag-remove and search decide state through the interaction and field-action kernels; one ds-select vocabulary (the rottay-select option and optgroup compounds answer to ds-select-option/ds-select-optgroup). fanOutUnreached=1 stays for adjudication: recipe-profile, whose only channel is provenance owned by WO-DER-06.

auto-complete.cutNote: WO-FAM-03: channels written by derivation/chrome/auto-complete and presentation/components/auto-complete; the skin folder and the vocabulary are ds-auto-complete, so the family name, the skin and the channel namespace agree; options walk through runtime/collection/listbox and Enter commits through resolveSubmitIntent.

cascader.cutNote: WO-FAM-03: channels written by derivation/chrome/cascader and presentation/components/cascader; columns walk through runtime/collection/listbox with roving focus across columns, the dropdown rides useFieldOverlay, and option rows decide state through the interaction kernel.

tree-select.cutNote: WO-FAM-03: channels written by derivation/chrome/tree-select and presentation/components/tree-select; tree rows walk through runtime/collection/listbox and roving focus, the indent is the --ds-tree-select-level runtime channel, and the copy renders with an English floor without a provider.

mentions.cutNote: WO-FAM-03: channels written by derivation/chrome/mentions and presentation/components/mentions; suggestions walk through runtime/collection/listbox (disabled rows are skipped), composition keys never commit through isComposingKey, and autosize writes --ds-mentions-autosize-* runtime channels instead of inline paint.

transfer.cutNote: WO-FAM-03: channels written by derivation/chrome/transfer and presentation/components/transfer; panel rows walk through runtime/collection/listbox and move, select-all and pagination controls decide state through the interaction kernel; one ds-transfer vocabulary. Transfer opens no overlay, so useFieldOverlay does not apply.

date-picker.cutNote: WO-FAM-03: channels written by derivation/chrome/date-picker and presentation/components/date-picker; the grid, week start, weekday order, day labels and grid keyboard come from the calendar kernel (foundation/calendar), the panel from useFieldOverlay, and triggers, navigation, cells, Today and clear decide state through the interaction and field-action kernels; one ds-date-picker vocabulary.

time-picker.cutNote: WO-FAM-03: channels written by derivation/chrome/time-picker and presentation/components/time-picker; columns walk through runtime/collection/listbox and hop in the reading direction, the panel rides useFieldOverlay with the contract placements mapped onto the kernel, and cells, Now and clear decide state through the interaction and field-action kernels; one ds-time-picker vocabulary.

color-picker.cutNote: WO-FAM-03: channels written by derivation/chrome/color-picker and presentation/components/color-picker, with the swatch and preset colours carried as --ds-color-picker-* user-data channels; the trigger, fields, presets and clear decide state through the interaction kernel and every contract placement maps onto useFieldOverlay; one ds-color-picker vocabulary.
